messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites Java 8 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class textdocumentanalysis {
	static int count_inside_braces = 0, longest_word = 0;

	public static int remove_underscore(String str) {
		str = str.replaceAll("_", " ");
		str = str.trim().replaceAll(" +", " ");
		String s[] = str.split(" ");
		if (s.length == 1 && s[0].equals(""))
			return 0;
		return s.length;
	}

	public static void main(String args[]) {
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = sc.nextInt();
		String s = sc.next();
		ArrayList<Integer> braces_indices = new ArrayList<Integer>();
		braces_indices.add(-1);
		for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
			if (s.charAt(i) == '(' || s.charAt(i) == ')')
				braces_indices.add(i);
		}
		int i = 1, count = 0, maxl = 0;
		String outside_braces = "";
		while (i < braces_indices.size() - 1) {
			int open_brace_index = braces_indices.get(i);
			int close_brace_index = braces_indices.get(i + 1);
			String inside_braces = s.substring(braces_indices.get(i) + 1, braces_indices.get(i + 1));
			count = remove_underscore(inside_braces);
			count_inside_braces += count;
			outside_braces += "_" + s.substring(braces_indices.get(i - 1) + 1, braces_indices.get(i));
			i += 2;
		}
		outside_braces += "_" + s.substring(braces_indices.get(braces_indices.size() - 1) + 1);
		outside_braces = outside_braces.replaceAll("_", " ");
		outside_braces = outside_braces.trim().replaceAll(" +", " ");
		String s_new[] = outside_braces.split(" ");
		for (int j = 0; j < s_new.length; j++) {
			if (s_new[j].length() > maxl)
				maxl = s_new[j].length();
		}

		System.out.print(maxl + " " + count_inside_braces);
	}
}
